theorems.name: Submission.smr_exists_continuous_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U k, (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → X.massOn W < ∞) → ∃ L : (Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) k) → ℝ, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, L (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) = X ω) ∧ (∀ φ ψ : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) k, Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → Continuous ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ U → L (φ + ψ) = L φ + L ψ) ∧ (∀ (c : ℝ) (φ : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) k), Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → L (c • φ) = c * L φ) ∧ ∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ φ : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) k, Continuous φ → tsupport φ ⊆ K → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (φ x) ≤ 1) → |L φ| ≤ B
